tier_hints.propose: Reads, and proposes changes. Every write waits for a reviewer.
tier_hints.trusted: May do what the workspace policy allows it. Writing without review still needs a policy rule that says so — this on its own does not grant it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.token_once: Copy the token now. It is stored as a hash and cannot be shown again.

ai.intro: Knoverge does not need an AI provider. Connect one and search also finds knowledge that says the same thing in different words; without one, everything else works exactly as it does now.
ai.empty: Nothing is connected. Search, proposals, review, history and the MCP endpoint all work; what is missing is the half of search that matches meaning rather than words.

embedding.title: Embeddings
embedding.description: The model that turns knowledge into vectors, so a search for "how we sign people in" can find a note about passwordless login.
embedding.not_in_use: Connected, and not used for anything.

generation.description: A model that writes: summaries of a set of items, and the optional narrative on an activity digest. Nothing needs it — a summary can be written by hand and a digest counts what happened either way.
generation.provider_gone: The provider it named is no longer configured.
generation.title: Generation

wizard.model_failed: The model did not return a vector.
wizard.model_generation_hint: Only models the provider says can complete text. Changing it later changes nothing already written; a summary keeps the model it was made with.

wizard.no_models: This provider holds no model that can embed. Pull one — bge-m3 and nomic-embed-text are the usual choices — and check again.
